reviewer: Measure Review B (security and data handling)
summary: Shared auth foundation (packages/auth + packages/auth-client) is solid. All 16 auth_security_hardening_20260611 FRs verified resolved. No Critical or High findings. 3 Medium findings (in-memory rate limiter with planned fix, no CSRF tokens, cookie secure flag gated on NODE_ENV). 4 Low findings. No JWT/Firebase remnants. Architecture aligned with AGENTS.md.

findings.description: In-memory Map-based rate limiter resets on process restart and does not coordinate across instances. Pending remediation track rate_limiter_v2_20260603 exists.
No CSRF token implementation. Relies solely on sameSite: 'lax' cookie attribute for CSRF defense on login/logout endpoints.
Cookie 'secure' flag is gated on NODE_ENV === 'production'. In staging deployments with HTTPS but non-production NODE_ENV, cookies lack the secure flag.
bcryptjs remains as transitional runtime dependency for legacy hash verification. Correct transitional design; needs scheduled removal date.
Session token hashing uses SHA-256 without salt. Mitigated by 256-bit CSPRNG tokens making rainbow tables infeasible.
safeMetadata() only redacts top-level PII keys; nested objects with PII keys pass through unredacted.
Login response is not validated against a Zod schema before setting auth state.

gates_run.note: Lint and check-types not run per review-only track policy (no code changes made). Tests timed out at 120s (requires PostgreSQL).

anti_pattern_checks.A2_note: No publish gate in this phase; no draft-to-published status flip to audit.
